posts.title: Parallel Workers Can Overtake the Oldest Job
posts.summary: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED is a practical way for concurrent workers to claim different rows without waiting on each other. It also lets later jobs pass a locked earlier job, so FIFO order, fairness, and recovery need an explicit design outside the locking clause.

posts.title: Retry Queues Need Deadlines, Not Just Attempt Counts
posts.summary: Attach an expiry to retryable work. The deadline protects systems from turning a temporary dependency failure into stale, surprising side effects.
